summary: GCL Global Holdings Ltd., a Cayman Islands holding company listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K on August 6, 2026, announcing its intent to propose an adjournment of its Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) scheduled for August 7, 2026, to December 1, 2026. The stated reason is to allow time to assess compliance with Nasdaq listing requirements, specifically whether a proposed share consolidation is necessary. The filing includes a press release with no financial terms, advisor, or recommendation. This is a procedural corporate governance event rather than a special-situation transaction. What to watch: the outcome of the EGM adjournment vote and any subsequent Nasdaq compliance actions.
